Calculate GO enrichment from cluster-specific DE genes

calculate_go.Rd

Identify cluster-specific differentially expressed genes across normalisation methods and perform Gene Ontology enrichment for each cluster.

Usage

calculate_go(
  norm_list,
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  methods = names(norm_list),
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  OrgDb,
  key_type = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "BP",
  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  min_prop = 0.7,
  min_spots = 30,
  min_genes = 10,
  pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
  qvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

Arguments

norm_list

Named list of normalised SpatialExperiment objects.

cluster_col

Name of the colData column containing cluster assignments.

methods

Optional character vector specifying the normalisation methods to analyse.

assay_name

Name of the assay used for differential expression analysis.

OrgDb

Organism annotation database passed to `clusterProfiler::enrichGO()`.

key_type

Gene identifier type.

ont

Gene Ontology category. One of `"BP"`, `"MF"`, `"CC"`, or `"ALL"`.

fdr_cutoff

FDR threshold used to define significant cluster-specific DE genes.

min_prop

Minimum proportion passed to `scran::findMarkers()`.

min_spots

Minimum number of spatial locations required for a cluster.

min_genes

Minimum number of DE genes required to run GO enrichment.

pvalue_cutoff

GO enrichment p-value cutoff.

qvalue_cutoff

GO enrichment q-value cutoff.

p_adjust_method

Multiple-testing correction method.

readable

Logical indicating whether gene IDs should be converted to readable symbols.

Value

A list containing:

  • `markers`: full marker results for each method.

  • `genes`: significant DE genes used for GO.

  • `go`: GO enrichment results.

  • `universe`: background genes for each method.

Details

Each normalisation method should contain one SpatialExperiment object representing the same spatial sample.
